Posted 'Profit/Be Destoryed' dested You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed; 'TatJabba's Palace' the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'TatCantina' Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'JPEntrance Cavern' and 'JPAudience Chamber' the Light Jabba's Palace sites; 'TatObi's Hut' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut.

Posted 'Obi, Padawan Learner' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Artoo' Artoo (Jabba's Palace); 'Qui-Gon' Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Qui-Gon's Saber' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, after this post); 'Weapon Levitation' the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; 'Leia w/Blaster' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han w/Blaster' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Lando w/Ax' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Sorry about the mess/blaster prof' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.
